column3: Close to the Hebrew; “nine of the hands” is rendered “nine-tenths,” and NKJV supplies “other.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the temple servants” is transliterated “Nethinim.”
Close to the Hebrew; the name “Hassenuah/Senaah” is spelled “Senuah.”
NKJV translates the name הַגְּדוֹלִים (“the great ones”) as “the son of one of the great men.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the temple servants” is transliterated “the Nethinim.”
Close to the Hebrew; וַאֲמָנָה (“a firm ordinance”) is rendered “a certain portion,” and “for them” is linked to the singers.
Close to the Hebrew; “at the king’s hand” is rendered “the king’s deputy.”
